## Approved plan task C2

- **Functional scope/files:** Engine role API and a minimal Engine-owned composition of authentication, trusted widget conversation/config/transcript binding, initialization and `Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3`. Reuse the existing TranscriptHistory permission/scope/projection/pagination implementation; do not rebuild it. Reuse PeopleConversations where its bearer semantics match C1. Keep adapter-specific event names/topics out of Engine.
- **Contract:** authenticated actor/proof and server-resolved config scope in; created/resumed conversation or bounded ordered history out. Authenticate/authorize both init/history and message conversation association. Unknown and inaccessible conversations have a non-enumerating public error. No browser-supplied owner, actor or bypass is trusted.
- **Action prerequisite:** only if existing public APIs cannot compose the selected initialization/binding operation, create a focused Action issue with schemas, validated execution, errors and transaction semantics before C3. Canonical history already exists; a new read/permission/pagination engine is not a prerequisite. Context APIs retain persistence and canonical reader authorization; the Engine facade authenticates and resolves scope. Code/transport consumers are in scope; agent registry exposure is not.
- **Tests before implementation:** extend canonical history/scoped persistence integration coverage: permitted/denied Person, foreign widget/config, missing identity, expired/revoked auth where applicable, disabled config, deleted conversation/transcript, forged BO capability, existing reader cursor/limit behavior, creation failure and correct message-to-transcript association. Cover legacy transcript rejection and private execution-field exclusion; property-test trusted binding across generated IDs.
- **Branches:** all accepted principal types from C1 and every rejection path; nil person never grants elevated access. Revalidate resumed IDs before pipeline persistence, not only during widget initialization.
- **Mocking:** real Engine/Repo/auth boundaries; only external authentication transport if C1 introduces one.
- **Documentation:** Engine service contract and permission/ownership rules, linked from Channels.
- **Action reuse:** reuse canonical reader authorization/projection, scoped persistence, history strategy and identity resolution; implement only missing authenticated binding/initialization and role dispatch. Record inputs, outputs, errors, side effects and retry policy. No broad Accounts.History recall or super-admin `list_admin` shortcut for widget reads.
- **Done:** widget history reaches the existing authorized canonical reader through NodeRouter with a verified Person and trusted transcript binding; initialization/send cannot use an unscoped fallback to access a foreign conversation. BO restoration stays behaviorally unchanged.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.9 (C1).
Blocks zaq-pkd.11 (C3).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.
title: [830] C2 — Integrate widget identity/init with existing authorized canonical history
